title: Trail runner on a green tyre stack

tokens.v: The trail shoe perches on the rim of the top tyre, toe hanging just over the edge, its bone and burnt-orange upper the only warm colour in a world of glossy kelly green. Hard key light from the upper left, a crisp shadow dropping into the tyre, the gloss of the paint catching long highlights. 50mm from the height of the top tyre, the shoe large in the upper half.
